title: Normal Zeeman splitting of an l = 1 level
caption: In a field B the magnetic moment gives each m_l level a shift m_lμ_BB with μ_B = 57.88 μeV T⁻¹. In 1 T the three levels of an l = 1 level move to +57.9, 0 and −57.9 μeV, so adjacent levels are μ_BB = 57.9 μeV = 5.8 × 10⁻⁵ eV apart, and the splitting grows in proportion to B.
alt: Graph of energy shift in microelectronvolts against magnetic field from 0 to 2 tesla: three straight lines from the origin with gradients plus 57.9, zero and minus 57.9 microelectronvolts per tesla for m equal to 1, 0 and -1.
description: The horizontal axis is the magnetic flux density in tesla; the vertical axis is the shift of the energy level in μeV.
Each level moves by m_lμ_BB, so the lines have gradients +57.9, 0 and −57.9 μeV per tesla for m_l = +1, 0, −1.
At B = 1 T the levels are at +57.9, 0 and −57.9 μeV: adjacent levels are 57.9 μeV = 5.8 × 10⁻⁵ eV apart.
